en-US.author: Perforce Software, Inc.

en-US.description: OpenLogic's free, certified builds of OpenJDK 25 (JDK) with HotSpot, based on GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS sources.
en-US.longDescription:
OpenLogic provides free, certified builds of OpenJDK from multiple versions of OpenJDK across various operating systems and architectures. The builds are covered by OpenLogic's commercial support offering but may be used freely without any support commitment.
This package installs the OpenJDK 25 JDK with HotSpot for Windows. The installer registers the runtime in Windows Programs and Features, exposes the JDK tools on the PATH, and associates .jar files so they can be run directly.
en-US.name: OpenLogic-OpenJDK JDK with Hotspot 25

zh-CN.description: OpenLogic 提供的免费、经过认证的 OpenJDK 25（JDK）构建版，含 HotSpot 虚拟机。
zh-CN.longDescription:
OpenLogic 提供 OpenJDK 多个版本的免费认证构建版，覆盖多种操作系统与架构。这些构建版可由 OpenLogic 的商业支持服务提供保障，也可在没有任何支持承诺的情况下自由使用。
本包在 Windows 上安装 OpenJDK 25 JDK（HotSpot 虚拟机）。安装程序会将该运行时注册到 Windows 的“程序和功能”中，把相关工具目录加入 PATH，并关联 .jar 文件以便直接运行。
